ac506d86c6fd.t: What recoverystarts.com collects, why, and what it never does. Plain language, no small print.

2fa7ec5d2cd3.t: What this site collects, why, and what it never does.

e08346cb3fda.t: <0>Who we are.</0> recoverystarts.com is run by Recovery Starts, a project of <1>AutoGrow AI Solutions</1>, Calgary, Alberta, Canada. You can reach us at <2>derick@autogrow.org</2>.

eb15e578f356.t: You never need an account to use this site.

ba4109d46083.t: We count visits so we know which pages help people and where to improve.

be8739082595.t: Nothing you read here is tied to your name.

1f265c7e3d6e.t: <0>Visit counts.</0> We use Google Analytics and Cloudflare Web Analytics. They tell us things like how many people visited, which pages they read, roughly which country they came from, and what kind of device they used. Google Analytics sets cookies in your browser to do this, and we ask it to shorten your IP address. You can read how Google uses this data in <1>Google’s Privacy Policy</1>. Cloudflare Web Analytics uses no cookies.

4c9e70bb62e1.t: <0>Your language choice.</0> If you pick a language, your browser remembers it (a small cookie or local storage on your device) so the next page opens in that language. It stays on your device.

b83dfa7e031c.t: <0>The “add a meeting” form.</0> What you type is emailed to us so a person can add the meeting. Your email address is optional and only used to reply to you. Nothing from the form is published automatically.

39d86727670c.t: <0>Donations.</0> If you give, the payment happens on Stripe’s or PayPal’s own pages. We never see your card details.

299cf7a91b92.t: <0>Recovery Einstein.</0> The chat app at app.recoverystarts.com and the Android app have their own <1>privacy policy</1>.

9f5db589a60e.t: Ads keep this site free. Google and its advertising partners may use cookies to show ads based on your visits to this site and other sites. You can turn off personalised ads at <0>adssettings.google.com</0>, and learn about other companies’ ad cookies at <1>aboutads.info</1>. An ad never changes which meetings you see.

cfbc9950274b.t: <0>Advertising.</0> CMI Marketing, Inc., d/b/a Raptive (“Raptive”) is a service provider of this Site for the purposes of placing advertising on the Site, and Raptive will collect and use certain data for advertising purposes. To learn more about Raptive’s data usage, click here: <1>https://raptive.com/creator-advertising-privacy-statement/</1>

936ccd898017.t: <0>Your privacy signals and choices.</0> Our ad code honours the Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal: if your browser sends it, your visit is treated as an opt-out of the sale or sharing of your personal information for advertising. Visitors in the United States will see a “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information” link at the bottom of the page; after you opt out, the same link lets you turn personalised ads back on. Visitors in the UK, the European Economic Area and Switzerland are asked for consent before any personalised ads are shown, and can change that choice at any time with the “Update Privacy Preferences” link at the bottom of the page.

8a0c52d9c803.t: Block or delete cookies in your browser settings. The site still works.

0d963bd96470.t: Stop Google Analytics everywhere with Google’s <0>opt-out add-on</0>.

6c7309c56579.t: Ask us what we have about you, or ask us to delete it: <0>derick@autogrow.org</0>.
